parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6. Significant val_bpb improvement from 1.102 to 1.015. The extra capacity seems to fit well within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll experiment with MATRIX_LR to see if we can push this further now that we have a deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increased DEPTH to 6 and bumped MATRIX_LR to 0.1 to capitalize on higher capacity and more aggressive learning.
